name: Neoclerodane-Like KOR Trap
description: Salvinorin-inspired rigid bicyclic lactone — G=𐑚 (local) and K=𐑺 (MBL) via rigid caged structure
rationale: K=𐑺 (many-body localized / frozen disorder) requires extreme rigidity. The bicyclo[2.2.2]octane core is nearly rigid with no rotatable bonds in the ring system. G=𐑚 (local cardinality) realized by no extended conjugation — each functional group acts independently. F=𐑞 (thermal fidelity) via ester linkages that are thermally labile.
